title: Room CO2 mass balance
author: THC Educational Content Production
alt: Conceptual room CO2 mass balance showing outdoor air and supplemental CO2 entering, ventilation exhaust leaving, and net plant uptake reducing CO2 during photosynthesis.
caption: Room CO2 concentration reflects supply, air exchange and biological uptake. Conceptual diagram; arrow widths are not measured flow rates and no crop setpoint is recommended.
